algorithm.title: Small for Gestational Age (SGA)/Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR): Fetal Assessment.

cell.label: Maternal disease or risk factor, concerning fetal growth pattern, or routine screen
Estimated fetal weight or abdominal circumference <10%, no other abnormality.
Repeat ultrasound with fetal measurements and Doppler of umbilical artery in 2-4 weeks.
Normal growth rate and Doppler, small parents?
Abnormal growth rate or Doppler or development of oligohydramnios.
High risk for IUGR: close surveillance (biophysical profile, nonstress test, multivessel Doppler), delivery when indicated.
Small fetal size plus oligohydramnios, polyhydramnios, or fetal anomaly?
